narrative.headline: 2019 Jeep Cherokee: the transmission tops owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 1,567 complaints with NHTSA. The power train (transmission and drivetrain) is by far the biggest issue at 47%, followed by the engine (29%) and electrical system (21%). No deaths are reported. The engine area has the most fires (11), while the brakes draw the fewest complaints but the most injuries (7) of any area, so test both carefully.
